guide.setup: Sit with the lower back and hips against the pad, feet about shoulder width on the platform, and knees tracking over the toes.
guide.execution: Lower the sled to a comfortable depth without the hips rolling up, then press through the whole foot without snapping the knees straight.
guide.cues: Keep the lower back planted. Use full-foot pressure. Control the sled.
guide.mistakes: Letting the pelvis tuck under; locking knees hard; going beyond hip control; feet placed too low for comfort.
